text_block_list.text:
A dog show sponsored by an URA-affiliated 
company. The academy received an 
invitation, and today I was asked to 
chaperone students who wished to attend.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...A familiar breeze has blown this way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ruby-san, you came as well? I did not see 
you on the shuttle bus...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I arrived separately from the academy 
today. Our family received an invitation 
to enter the competition, so I have come 
as our representative.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, participating in the event? Then this 
little one must be your partner, Ruby-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes, her name is Saphir. If you will 
excuse me, our turn is approaching, so I 
must take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Saphir. Stand up. ...We must deliver a 
result worthy of our family name without 
fail.

Daiichi Ruby and her dog took part in the 
canine freestyle dance. Saphir matched 
Daiichi Ruby's movements with flawless 
steps, captivating the audience.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The winner of the Dog Dance division is 
Daiichi Ruby-san and her beloved partner 
Saphir!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
An auspicious breeze... What a wonderful 
dance that was. Saphir-san did her very 
best for your sake, Ruby-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. When the winner was announced, she 
looked so remarkably proud.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
She has received proper training. It is 
merely the outcome expected of her 
upbringing.
choice_data_list:
Th-The next event is about to start, so 
let's watch.

text_block_list.text:
Shortly after the obstacle agility course 
began, Saphir, watching the event, grew 
visibly restless.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Pant pant pant...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Saphir. Be quiet.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Are you not entering the obstacle 
course, Ruby-san? It looks quite 
enjoyable.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Our duty is to produce results solely in 
the category we were requested to enter.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Pant pant pant...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No. Be quiet, Saphir.

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Whimper...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...It seems she is trying to tell you 
something. Saphir-san, would you share 
your feelings... with me?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...I see, I see... Fufu. Waiting for the 
wind... is it? It seems there is something 
she wants to convey to you, Ruby-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Are you truly claiming you can 
understand the heart of an animal?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you look into their eyes and face them 
closely, you can feel it. Surely you, who 
stay by her side, can feel it even better 
than I.

With a tense expression, Daiichi Ruby 
crouched down in front of Saphir. Saphir 
looked at her owner with expectant eyes, 
waiting for a response.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ... ...What should I do from here?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Do not take your eyes off her, and listen 
to her feelings. The swirling wind is 
waiting for that moment.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Saphir. What is in your heart?

text_block_list.name: Saphir
text_block_list.text: Woof! Pant pant... *lick lick*...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —?! ...Saphir, you—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...You want to play with me. That is what 
you desire right now, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
She definitely started getting fidgety 
after watching the competition.

She definitely started getting fidgety 
after watching the competition.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. A brief moment should not be 
an issue.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Only until the closing ceremony begins. 
Understood, Saphir?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Come here!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. It looks like two whirlwinds 
dancing together.

Yamanin Zephyr gently watched over Saphir 
and Daiichi Ruby as they ran innocently 
together.
